description.purpose: Expose the frozen cross-venue public streaming observation as a governed, read-only analytical data product.

description.usage: Use for monitoring, replay, market-structure analysis, or model evaluation that preserves the exact evidence version and its no-write boundary.

context.instructions: Treat this product as historical read-only public observation. Preserve source/receive timestamps and the exact source SHA-256. Separate observed quotes from derived cross-venue comparisons.

Do not turn bounded cross-venue observations into an alpha, arbitrage, or price-direction claim without separate evidence.
Do not infer private account holdings, positions, or permissions from this public observation product.
